hints.title: Path Generation
hints.text: Generate all legal directional paths and step lengths for each piece on the eight by eight board.

hints.title: Pairwise Compatibility
hints.text: Check collisions incrementally between pairs of pieces along their simultaneous movement paths.

hints.title: Stationary Retention
hints.text: Once a piece reaches its destination, it remains stationed on that square for all subsequent seconds.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M^N) backtracking with incremental collision checks
complexity.space: O(N) recursion stack and trajectory tracking
complexity.notes: Pieces move simultaneously and stay at their destination once reached.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating full board states per second without pairwise collision pruning blows up.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Incremental pairwise validation prunes invalid configurations immediately.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should simulate simultaneous trajectories step-by-step.
